name: bite_down_hits_a_planeswalker_you_dont_control
note: Bite Down: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.' P0's 3/3 Wolf deals 3 damage to the opponent's Vivien Reid (loyalty 5), which loses three loyalty counters (CR 120.3c): 2 left. The Wolf is dealt nothing (a bite is one-sided, unlike a fight).
